text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Pandora. Have you finished your 
assignment yet?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Not yeeet. I'll do it once I finish 
reading this~."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a shame. ...If you were done, I 
was thinking we could watch Season 5 of 
'Totally Agents!' together.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh! Wait, the stream already started!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, since yesterday. ...So, what's the 
plan?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“—Today's training is off-campus. I'll be 
back late, so keep that in mind.”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Ehhhh, are you for reaaal!? Now I have to 
dry my hair myself~. Ugggh!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what about that new quick-drying 
towel you bought the other day? Have you 
tried it out yet?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's right, I totally forgot! 
...Then I'll try that today☆

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――Well now. Guess I'll hurry back to my 
room and eat that ice cream I bought 
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Don't eat it all by yourself! I told 
you I wanted to try that flavor too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
But I can't wait~. It's your fault for 
dawdling♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez! Heart-chan, you're so impatient! 
Wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. That's Heart for you. She really 
knows how to get you fired up.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Flattered~?? Ehh~ it's not like I'm 
letting it get to my head or anything...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: What a...—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Maybe so...?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, Heart-chan's just beating me every 
single time! I'm not okay with this~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I can do that much too, y'know! —Don't 
underestimate a genius~!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Leaving the laundry scattered all 
over the place again. Now then, how shall 
I motivate them this time?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Wait. ...Could this possibly lead outside 
the room?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...What an unusual Hansel and Gretel. 
Just what are they scheming, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
This is the last sock. ...It looks like 
the goal is just ahead, though.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu! Now, let's see what comes out.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! I knew it! I'm just a huge 
genius~♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, I wonder what kind of game 
she's so engrossed in today?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Now, now, just watch me~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
On the count of... three! First up, 
Heart-chan's absolute favorite: a shark—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—wasn't there, so tuna it is! Annnnd... 
cue the music~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Wow! Oh my gosh!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on! Let's party♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: E-Eh? Geez, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yay yay♪ WOO HOOOO~♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Pfft! Heheh, ahahaha! You're so 
crazy!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yeah～!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Did that get you hyped 
up~?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Totally! Seriously, it's the abso-lute 
best!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! ...Then, then, can you help me put 
away the laundry?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. I suppose it can't be helped... 
I'll allow it just this once♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Yay~♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Then while we're at it, let's do our 
homework together too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Okey-doke! Let's wrap this up quick☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—And just like that~ I safely maintained 
my genius dignity☆
